It doesn't make you vomit blood "because it's too spooky", it makes you vomit blood because it's an evil spirit messing with you both mentally and physically, but the Foundation scientists can't find any actual wounds or other signs of direct influence beyond what could be considered "natural, but accelerated".

They have yet to run tests with anyone for whom "being chased by a vindictive entity that is supremely sadistic and actively wants to torture and murder you" is a preferable state than being lonely. Robots don't dream (not via biological means, anyway) so he couldn't do anything. Aliens… Would be in a different cell in a different wing, and cross-testing is prohibited =P

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Quite frankly, there is simply too much here. It is a massive wall of text that describes every detail of 965 in a very uninteresting way. It's like you wrote 965, thought to yourself, "Hmmm. This isn't creepy enough" and began piling on details.

It stares at you through the window, making you paranoid. Oh, and it also can move between windows. Oh, and it also starts cutting people in their sleep. Oh, and these cuts turn out to make runes of some kind. Oh, it also engraves the final rune in your heart. Oh, it also seems to be getting stronger each time it kills some one.

I love the idea of a creepy guy staring at you through your window who makes you piss blood. Everything else seems too much. I would be in favor of seeing this SCP stripped down. Less is more.

Edit: And the [DATA EXPUNGED] doesn't add to the creep factor without any hints. As it is, it seems like a bit of a cop-out.

item.content:encoded:
I'm probably going to go in and fix that up a bit; it seemed to flow better in my head when I read it out. Basically it's thus:

The cuts happen inside the body, shallow incisions around the intestines, stomach, etc. The final cut is made on the heart itself, which is the one that causes enough damage to actually kill the person outright, though obviously lack of medical care could lead to death from the rest as well via internal bleeding, infection, etc.

The "reaching the skin" is due to the cuts becoming more severe with additional victims at the same time, going from smaller cuts inside to deep and violent gashes; they're basically getting carved up from the inside out, rather than from the skin down to the core.
